participation.context: Began on the uncertainty of the season, and then agreed the sleeves would do.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named payment on delivery, and refused to sew a hope.
participation.name: Edith Kettlewood

participation.context: Accepted the terms and cut the order to the sleeves at six shillings.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Said the uncertainty was her point, and stood with her.
participation.name: Will Kemp

relations.note: coin on delivery, not a promise
relations.quote: Pay me in coin, Master Heminges, and you may pay the weather in promises.

story.body: You started a speech about the season and were stopped. John bought the sleeves at six shillings, on delivery, and left the cloak unordered. Nothing was paid this morning.

story.body: You saw that you were not in Errors and went home.

title: Read the Errors bill and went home

story.body: You read the bill at the lodging and did not go out.
